- An Allen key adjusts the slot width from 14mm to 42mm, and it's listed for laptops up to 17.3". That makes it the better fit if you have a thick or large laptop, or want to store more than one device. ([aiwealth roundup](https://aiwealth.digitalpress.blog/5-best-vertical-laptop-stands-in-2026/))
- Price: $15 in a Nov 2025 deal, down from $30. ([Slickdeals](https://slickdeals.net/f/18761851-omoton-3-slot-adjustable-aluminum-vertical-laptop-stand-15-amazon))
